name: Nina T.
quote: Our galley kitchen felt stuck in the '90s. Apex Hearo reworked the layout, added an island, and kept the dust and noise to a minimum while we were still living in the house. We practically live in this kitchen now — it was worth every bit of the disruption.

name: Agnes D.
quote: We wanted a backyard unit for my mother without a year of headaches. They handled the permitting, kept us updated every week, and the finished ADU is better built than our actual house. She moved in three weeks ahead of schedule.

name: Serafin P.
quote: I got quotes from four contractors and Apex Hearo was the only one who gave me a straight answer on cost and timeline upfront — and stuck to both. The tile work in the shower is flawless.

name: Nancy V.
quote: They helped us pick finishes we never would've landed on ourselves, and the kitchen came out better than the photos I'd been saving for years. The crew showed up on time every single day, which after two bad contractor experiences was a huge relief.

name: Mui T.
quote: They built us a detached ADU for my in-laws and treated it with the same care as a custom home — real insulation, real finishes, not just a shed with plumbing. Our neighbors keep asking who did the work.
